title: The Day of the Two Lion Shirts
skyStory: The moon has strutted into Leo at forty-four percent, wearing sunglasses at night and expecting applause. Leo is the lion, the performer, the one who sings in grocery store aisles. Tonight it has arranged a small cosmic prank: two lions in two places at once. Mars thinks it's hilarious. Saturn checks the security footage and finds nothing. The lions are very good.

reading: A Leo moon is a big cat visiting a big cat, and the Fire Tiger is ready to purr. Your charm is turned up to eleven. People will laugh at jokes that are honestly only a seven. Enjoy it. You've earned an easy room.

Then, around 12:45, a stranger will walk past wearing a shirt covered in tiny lions. You'll laugh and send Nancy a photo. Within an hour she'll send one back: a different stranger, a different town, the same tiny lions. DES. The [[Strength]] card is grinning somewhere, gently holding a lion's jaw like it's a teacup.
joel.mission: Tell one joke today that you're not sure will land, and commit to it completely, including the pause.
joel.omen: A cat sunning itself on a car hood. Take your time; confidence is the slowest walk in the room.

reading: The Leo moon puts you on stage whether you signed up or not. Someone will ask you to explain something to a group, and your hands will take over like they've been waiting all week. People lean in. Somebody takes notes on a napkin.

Later, the lions arrive: a stranger on the sidewalk in a shirt full of them, just as Joel's message about his own lion shirt lands. Don't even scream. Well. Maybe one small scream into a scarf. The Wood Rat notes the time for the record, because the Wood Rat keeps records. It was 1:38.
nancy.mission: Explain something you love to someone who knows nothing about it, using your hands as much as possible.
nancy.omen: A lion statue outside a building you pass every day but never noticed. Look again at what's familiar.

together.text: Two lions, two towns, one ΔΕΣ. Celebrate it properly: each of you strike a ridiculous lion pose somewhere public-ish, a hallway or a parking lot, and send proof. Roars are optional but strongly encouraged by the moon.
